edges.rationale: Settings renders DangerZoneSection inside the Security tab
Settings renders BillingSectionContent inside the Billing tab Subscription Details card
handleProfileSave is defined inside the Settings default export and wired to the Save button
handlePasswordSave is defined inside Settings and wired to the Update Password button
handleNotificationChange is defined inside Settings and used by every notification ToggleSwitch
handlePrivacyChange is defined inside Settings and used by privacy selects/toggles
handleExportData is defined inside Settings and wired to the Export All Data button
handlePhotoChange is defined inside Settings; avatar upload is deferred to the /profile page so it is not currently wired
Profile tab is conditionally rendered when activeTab === profile
Security tab is rendered when activeTab === security and includes DangerZoneSection
Notifications tab is rendered when activeTab === notifications
Privacy tab is rendered when activeTab === privacy
Billing tab is rendered when activeTab === billing and includes Pro Pass card
Appearance tab is rendered when activeTab === appearance and includes dark mode + language
useAuth() provides user, refreshUser, logout; logout is called after deactivation/deletion/password change
useTheme() powers the dark mode toggle in the Appearance tab
useProPass() powers the Pro Pass card status, renewal date, and BillingSectionContent
All settings mutations and reads (authAPI.changePassword, userAPI.updateProfile/deleteAccount/getProfile/getAttempts/getAnalytics) go through dataService
handleProfileSave calls userAPI.updateProfile with name, mobile, dateOfBirth, education, bio, location
handlePasswordSave calls authAPI.changePassword(current, new) then logout
DangerZoneSection calls userAPI.updateProfile({ isActive: false }) and userAPI.deleteAccount()
handleExportData fans out to userAPI.getProfile, getAttempts, and getAnalytics in parallel
Billing tab documents the user-facing view of the Pro Pass subscription
handlePhotoChange calls userAPI.updateProfile({ avatar: dataURL }) after FileReader.readAsDataURL
fetchUsers is defined inside UsersManagerEnhanced and invoked on mount and on Refresh button click
doAction is defined inside UsersManagerEnhanced and backs every user mutation
updateUserStatus is defined inside UsersManagerEnhanced as a thin wrapper over doAction(status)
updateUserRole is defined inside UsersManagerEnhanced as a thin wrapper over doAction(role)
toggleProPass is defined inside UsersManagerEnhanced and prompts for passType before calling doAction(pro-pass)
viewEnrollments is defined inside UsersManagerEnhanced and triggered by the per-row Eye button
viewSessions is defined inside UsersManagerEnhanced and triggered by the per-row Smartphone button
revokeSession is defined inside UsersManagerEnhanced and wired to the per-session Trash button
updateSessionLimit is defined inside UsersManagerEnhanced and wired to the session-limit <select> in the Sessions tab
Bulk Actions bar is conditionally rendered when selectedUsers.length > 0 and showBulkActions is true
Pagination controls are rendered when totalPages > 1 using pageSize=20
Search input and Status/Role selects form the filter bar above the table
Stats Cards (Total/Active/Pro/Admins) are rendered at the top of the page
All admin HTTP calls go through the shared api client from shared/lib/api
fetchUsers GETs /api/admin/users to populate the table
fetchUsers GETs /api/admin/roles in parallel to populate the systemRoles option list
updateUserStatus PUTs /api/admin/users/:userId/status with { isActive }
updateUserRole PUTs /api/admin/users/:userId/role with the new role name
toggleProPass PUTs /api/admin/users/:userId/pro-pass with { isProUser, passType }
viewEnrollments GETs /api/admin/enrollments/user/:userId for the modal
viewSessions GETs /api/admin/users/:userId/sessions for the modal
revokeSession DELETEs /api/admin/sessions/:sessionId
updateSessionLimit PUTs /api/admin/users/:userId/session-limit with { sessionLimit }
Activate All / Deactivate All buttons call updateUserStatus for every selected id
Make Admin / Remove Admin buttons call updateUserRole for every selected id
toggleProPass grants/revokes the Pro Pass subscription with passType (pro_yearly/pro_monthly)
viewEnrollments synthesizes a synthetic Pro Pass entry into the enrollments list when the user isProUser
Settings is the default export declared in Settings.jsx
UsersManagerEnhanced is the default export declared in UsersManager.jsx
AuthContext must provide a logout that clears tokens so the post-deactivation/deletion/post-password-change redirect to /login is safe
Export-data flow depends on the backend returning success-wrapped payloads ({ data: { data: ... } }) from getProfile/getAttempts/getAnalytics
Filter bar assumes user records expose isActive, role, isProUser, and passType fields from the admin users endpoint
The Pro Pass is the same domain concept surfaced in both the user Settings billing view and the admin UsersManager grant/revoke UI
